patthana21.42:1.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:2.1: Naappaṭighaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:3.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighañca naappaṭighaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. (Sabbattha tīṇi.)
patthana21.42:4.1: Nasappaṭighaṃ naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:5.1: Naappaṭighaṃ naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
